body:
-My username is PNW_Bacon
-I was banned for Ban Evasion because of my friends PNW_007, and PNW_Waffle who were flying and screwing around and I told them to stop, but they wouldn't listen. I even mentioned that I could get banned because they were flying and they could think I was an alt, but they wouldn't listen :(
-I believe i should be unbanned because i didn't break the rules
